topic: keep travel documents safe while traveling
core_question: How do I keep my passport and other travel documents safe and organized while traveling? (secondary: How do I make my laptop battery last longer?)
answer_summary: Keep passport, tickets, and ID in a single dedicated travel wallet/organizer kept on your person, and make photocopies or photos of each document stored separately (and in cloud storage) as a backup in case of loss.; after the topic shift: Reduce screen brightness, close unused background apps, and enable the operating system's battery saver/power saving mode to extend runtime.
persona: skeptical and testy; texting quickly with typos here and there
